content: Modern real-time continuous glucose monitoring (rtCGM) devices have significantly reduced the need for frequent manual calibration, addressing a major limitation of earlier systems. This improvement enhances user convenience and simplifies the overall experience of glucose monitoring. Certain advanced rtCGM systems are equipped with auto-calibration features, eliminating the need for user intervention in this process. These technological advancements have proven to be highly advantageous for both adult and pediatric populations. They reduce the physical and psychological burden associated with traditional fingerstick blood glucose testing and facilitate more precise and responsive diabetes management strategies.
